emotional_tone: Authoritative, clear, precise, and highly functional. It should convey a sense of control and operational excellence.

rules: Headings MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Overlines and small labels MUST be uppercase with wide tracking.
Never center-align body text or data tables; default to left-align.

layout_and_spacing.base_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or grid-cols-12 for complex views
layout_and_spacing.padding: Generous internal padding for containers (p-6 or p-8).
rules: Use strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact spacing for data, but ample whitespace between distinct widgets.
Cardless or 1px border cards. Minimal border-radius (max 8px).
Dashboard components should stretch to fill grid height.
Use Shadcn for interactive logic (tables, calendars, dropdowns, dialogs).
Buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-md), flat colors, no heavy gradients.
Inputs: Clean, 1px border, clear focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4C9AFF]).
Tables: Zebra striping optional, clear column headers, dense padding (py-2 px-3) for maximum data density.
Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts for data visualization. Avoid D3 unless building custom geography/topology.

surface_styles.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#DFE1E6), no shadow by default. Hover: Slight lift, shadow-sm, border darkens.
surface_styles.header: Solid background (#FFFFFF) with a hard 1px bottom border. z-50 fixed or sticky.
surface_styles.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar for navigation. Light grey background (#F8F9FA) with 1px right border.

rules: Minimalist animations.
Hover states on all interactive elements (buttons, table rows, links).
Smooth state changes for dropdowns and dialogs (opacity and subtle transform).
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Use consistent stroke width (1.5 or 2).
Align icons optically with text.
Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.
Explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-[#0052CC] hover:text-white).
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
Focus states must be clearly visible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Master Admin CRM dashboard for 'TrataHealth'.
Main pages to build: 1. Dashboard/Overview, 2. Unified Contacts (Patients, Doctors, Hospitals), 3. Provider Acquisition Pipeline (Kanban), 4. Activities/Tasks, 5. Analytics.
The layout MUST include a collapsible left sidebar and a top sticky header.
Implement Progressive Disclosure: Show key KPIs at the top, followed by interactive tables and charts.
Use 'Chivo' for all headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Ensure these fonts are imported.
Implement the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' aesthetic: mostly white/grey backgrounds, sharp 1px borders, minimal shadow, and clear blue/green accents for actions and statuses.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively (Cards, Tables, Tabs, Select, Dialogs) but strip away heavy shadows or extreme rounded corners to fit the technical CRM look.
